purpose: normalized tournament metadata: official events from MunchStats, and Limitless online tournaments as their own population (event_tier "Online", ids prefixed "LP-")

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Primary key; upstream tournament event identifier

fields.name: event_tier
fields.description: Tournament tier: as reported by MunchStats for official events (e.g. Worlds, International, Regional, Special), if known; "Online" for every Limitless online tournament, a separate population never blended into official figures by default

fields.name: event_format
fields.description: Competitive format the event was played under: MunchStats' format string, e.g. "gen9championsvgc2026regmc" (Champions, Reg M-C) or "gen9vgc2026regi" (standard VGC), or Limitless' online label, e.g. "M-C". MunchStats indexes both games; this dimension is what scopes Champions-only analysis (see dbt/models/intermediate/int_champions_roster.sql). Optional: a few indexed events report no format

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: Champions regulation set the event was played under ("m-a", "m-b", "m-c"), resolved exactly from event_format via dbt/seeds/champions_regulations.csv. Same codes as legality_snapshot.regulation_code. Null only for non-Champions (standard VGC) events; a Champions event with no regulation fails assert_champions_formats_registered

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: "MunchStats" for official events, "Limitless Online" for online tournaments

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL or endpoint the record was resolved from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Upstream MunchStats event identifier, or the Limitless tournament id

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this row was published under
